title: Slovakian Sausage Bake
description: A hearty German-inspired casserole featuring Slovakian sausages, topped with a crispy bake crust. Serve with a side of tangy pickle slices.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the Slovakian sausages over medium-high heat until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the sausages to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the bake crumbs, pickle juice, and naughty (if using).
Spread the crumb mixture evenly over the top of the sausages.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sausages are cooked through.
